title: Core data after one choice
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a Boolean choice, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. If two configurations on $x$ have the same state, input-head position, work-tape contents and work-tape head positions, and their output words have the same summary (empty, exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$, or unable ever to become $[\mathrm{true}]$), then after one step under $b$ their resulting configurations have the same such core data and output summary.
